sample.title: Inside Hong Kong's Deadly Inferno | Exclusive Preview
sample.description:
Watch the full documentary on Bloomberg.com: https://bloom.bg/3VaGyGz

On November 26, 2025, Hong Kong firefighters were called to Wang Fuk Court, a complex of eight 31-story residential towers. What followed was the city’s deadliest fire in almost eight decades, an inferno that claimed 168 lives and triggered a year of recriminations over who was at fault.

Bloomberg Investigates examines the missed warnings and opportunities that preceded the disaster, one that continues to devastate the families of the dead and the fire's survivors to this day.

sample.title: Why Your Wall Outlet Is the Next Solar Frontier | Bloomberg Primer
sample.description:
US electricity prices have climbed more than 30% since 2020 and the federal tax credit that made rooftop solar more affordable is gone. Now a much smaller, cheaper option is spreading: plug-in solar. These panels cost a few hundred dollars and connect to a standard wall outlet. Germany has more than a million of these “balcony power plants.” But in the US, dozens of states are only now moving to legalize them, sometimes over utilities’ objections. Can a $300 panel give Americans a little more control over their electricity bills?
